_intention: External tool connections for Claude Code, via the Model Context Protocol. Committed to git so the whole team shares the same external surface. Secrets come from env vars - never hardcode tokens here.
_what_this_should_contain: One entry per server under mcpServers.<name>.
Each entry declares the command and args used to launch the server (typically `npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-<name>`).
Sensitive values reference env vars with ${VAR} - defined in .env.example and listed in CLAUDE.md.
